name: Hayes Manufacturing
old_description: Hayes Manufacturing’s mission is to deliver high-quality, reliable power transmission products for OEM applications across diverse markets. We prioritize customer satisfaction through precision engineering, innovation, and continuous improvement. Hayes values integrity and long-lasting relationships, supporting customer success with products that stand the test of time. We are committed to maintaining our reputation for excellence by consistently meeting the evolving needs of our customers.
about:
Hayes Manufacturing operates from a 33,000-square-foot facility in Fife Lake, Michigan. The company was founded in 1966 as a small garage job shop and has remained family-owned throughout its growth.

The company specializes in power transmission components for OEM applications, producing flywheel couplings, jaw couplings, bearing-supported stub shafts, engine housings, pump mount plates, SAE housing adapters, SAE stub shafts, generator drives, and dyno drive shafts. Its manufacturing capabilities are supported by a skilled engineering team and advanced equipment, though specific machine models are not disclosed.

Hayes serves OEM customers across diverse markets, including marine, irrigation, power generation, and dynamometer testing. Its product lines include marine couplings for Hurth/ZF transmissions, irrigation flywheel couplings, and generator drive systems. The company also supports custom-engineered product development for replacement parts or new designs.

As a division of the CK Power Family of Companies, Hayes leverages shared resources and expertise from five specialized divisions to tackle challenging projects and expand its offerings. The company emphasizes precision engineering, continuous improvement, and multilingual customer support in ten languages, aiming to deliver reliable components that stand the test of time.

HECA specializes in printed circuit board assembly using both surface-mount and through-hole technologies, supported by three SMT production lines that include complex component placers rated at 15,000 and 11,000 components per hour. The shop also provides cable and wire harness assembly, box build and sub-assemblies, component procurement, in-circuit test, functional test, and quick-turn prototype services, scaling from prototype to full production runs.

The company serves government and commercial customers with turnkey and consignment programs, offering RoHS/lead-free compliance and expertise in metal and plastic enclosures. Its customer base spans both public-sector and private-sector accounts.

HECA's stated mission emphasizes meeting or exceeding contracted requirements, on-time delivery, and continuous improvement under a quality management system certified to ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100D, aiming to be a preferred outsourcing partner.

The Wiegands and Youngs established the business as a locally owned and operated shop, with Rod’s background in fabrication and creative design complementing Troy’s three decades of shop-floor expertise.

The shop provides custom, production, and structural metal fabrication. Custom work covers one-off pieces such as handrails, signs, decorative trim, and cabinets, while production services handle larger runs of components for industrial machinery and brackets. Structural projects include steel beams, columns, staircases, and platforms, all designed with advanced software and built using a variety of metals in a facility described as state-of-the-art.

Customers range from industrial manufacturers needing high-volume brackets and machine components to commercial and residential clients seeking architectural metalwork for homes and offices. The company cites examples including custom steel features for home and office settings, as well as structural steel for building projects.

Heartland Fabrication emphasizes a mission of delivering exceptional fabrication with a commitment to quality, community, and customer loyalty. The founders say they strive to stay ahead by adopting the latest industry advancements and by building long-term relationships with clients and vendors.

name: Heisler Semiconductor LLC
old_description: Circuit and hardware design, firmware, advanced packaging, wafer-level, laser, and supply chain — backed by data and AI-assisted process control. One engineering team takes it from concept through volume, on US soil.
about:
Heisler Semiconductor operates a process and assembly lab in Halethorpe, Maryland. The company is a US-based, engineering-led advanced packaging team; no founding year or individual founders are disclosed in public materials.

The lab provides advanced packaging and wafer-level services including die attach, wire bonding, flip chip, hermetic sealing, and 3D integration; wafer-level processing such as lithography, TSV, deposition, etch, CMP, and RDL; laser micromachining for micro-vias, dicing, singulation, and marking; and inspection and metrology via X-ray, 3D AOI, SEM, and sub-micron metrology. The same engineering team also handles circuit, device, and hardware design, firmware development, RF evaluation boards, and domestic supply-chain management from prototype through qualified volume.

Heisler serves aerospace and defense, medical and bio, RF/mmWave, and advanced sensor programs where domestic provenance and high-reliability assembly are required. Customers include companies building MEMS, sensors, GaN and CMOS mixed-signal devices, and fine-pitch multi-die modules.

The company emphasizes a data-driven, AI-native approach: designed experiments (DOE) and statistical process control on every build, with AI surfacing drift and correlations to reduce trial-and-error iterations. All development and build work remains on US soil under an NDA-first policy, and the engineers who scope a job own it through qualification.

Helena Agri Enterprises was founded in 1957 in West Helena, Arkansas. The company now operates from its headquarters in Collierville, Tennessee, near Memphis, and maintains a retail and wholesale distribution network of more than 500 locations across the United States with a workforce exceeding 6,000 employees.

The company develops and manufactures crop input products for agriculture, turf, and ornamental markets, and pairs those products with application technology, precision data tools, and digital platforms. Its service portfolio includes agronomic consultation, custom application, financial services, and data management solutions designed to help growers manage their operations.

Helena serves farmers, growers, and turf professionals across the agriculture and specialty horticulture sectors. Its customer base ranges from large-scale row-crop operations to golf courses and landscape businesses, all supported by a nationwide network of local outlets.

The organization emphasizes a sustainability framework built on three pillars — People, Products, and Knowledge — and aligns its efforts with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals, targeting greenhouse gas reduction and community-focused initiatives.

old_description: Heltronics serves as a contract manufacturer of electromechanical subassemblies and box build assemblies for OEM and EMS companies. about:
Heltronics Inc. was established in 2008 in Reading, Pennsylvania, situated in Berks County with convenient access to Routes 222, 422, and I-76. The company operates as a contract manufacturer specializing in electromechanical and box build assemblies.

The firm provides a full suite of assembly services, including electromechanical assembly, box builds ranging from trailer-sized units to small power supplies, cable and wire harness fabrication, control panel and cabinet assembly, rework and refurbishment, and engineering and product support. Its facility is UL certified for the U.S. and Canada and staffed with IPC‑certified personnel (standards 610/620), supporting production needs from prototype runs to high‑volume monthly orders.

Heltronics serves OEMs and EMS companies across automotive, aerospace, industrial, medical, nuclear, and power and energy sectors, as well as electromedical diagnostic and electrotherapeutic device manufacturers. Customers range from startups requiring small prototype batches to large enterprises with recurring high‑volume demand.

The company emphasizes quality and customer support, holding ISO 9001:2015 certification through Dekra and membership in the Wire Harness Manufacturing Association. Its stated philosophy is to never compromise on quality, deliver quick turnaround times, and make the customer’s production goals its own.

about:
Hemingway Sewing Solutions operates from Hemingway, South Carolina, where it provides cut-and-sew contract manufacturing for apparel and bedding brands. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure in public materials.

The shop specializes in knit goods, producing men's and women's underwear, t-shirts, performance wear, and thermals, as well as engineered mattress covers that use combined panel-and-border designs to reduce sewing steps. Its service chain covers product development (prototypes, duplicates, pilot loads), precision cutting of fabrics including knits, rayon, polyester, lycra, spandex, cotton, and blends, sewing on automatic pocket setters, flat-seaming machines, and electronic elastic metering, and final packaging with inspection, pressing, tagging, and bagging.

Customers come from the apparel and sleep-product sectors, seeking a domestic partner for design-through-delivery programs. The company positions itself as a full-service apparel contract manufacturer capable of handling projects from sample to volume runs.

Management emphasizes a diverse, trained workforce and a "new dimension in knitting" that opens fresh design possibilities for mattress covers, though specific quality certifications or export registrations are not published.

name: Herb Sheet Metal Inc.
old_description: We are a family-owned and -operated business that offers custom metal and fiberglass duct board solutions in commercial and residential settings. Our experienced technicians work diligently to fabricate the most accurate product to suit your needs. Whether it's a DIY project or custom duct work, Herb Sheet Metal has you covered.
about:
Herb Sheet Metal Inc. was founded in 1952 in Lebanon, Pennsylvania, when Frank Herb and his sons Jack and Ray purchased the David High Metal Shop at 317 S. 6th St. for $6,000. The business, originally Frank L. The company has remained in the Herb family through four generations; Jack Herb Sr. led the firm until his death in 1996, followed by Jack Herb Jr., who retired in 2023 and passed ownership to his son Steve Herb Sr.

The shop produces custom metal and fiberglass duct board for commercial and residential HVAC systems. Its metalworking capabilities cover bending, rolling, welding, and plasma cutting of materials from 26 gauge to 11 gauge, primarily mild steel and aluminum. Fiberglass duct board is supplied flat or pre‑assembled in three thicknesses. The company also provides on‑site measurement, duct layout design, installation, and duct leakage testing.

Customers include mechanical contractors, builders, and DIY homeowners across central Pennsylvania. Projects range from simple cut‑and‑bend parts to intricate countertops and full ductwork systems for new construction and retrofit jobs.

Herb Sheet Metal emphasizes its multi‑generational family ownership and the continuity of hands‑on expertise, stating that experienced technicians fabricate each piece to the customer’s exact specifications.
